about: Tiki technique, balance and red-flag rules for the Tiki God generator. Ids match data/ingredients.json, data/families.json, data/vessels.json. Amounts are oz per single serving; metrics are post-dilution (web/lib/chem.js).

absoluteBands.about: Grams of sugar and acid per 100 ml of the finished, diluted drink (stats.sugarConc), by how it is made: the round-2 critic bands. A built or riffed drink is held inside its band after every pass; a classic poured as written keeps its spec (the 1934 Zombie sits near 3.6 g by design), and a directional ask (less sweet, very tart) moves the band. web/lib/chem.js sugarBand().

zeroProof.require: acid >= 0.45 g/100ml; body source (tea, coconut, nectar, ginger beer) present; one spice or bitter-free aromatic accent

methodFactor.blend: ice is part of drink: 0.9-1.2 of pre-dilution volume

angostura.exceptions: crown on crushed ice up to 0.25; bitters-base sour 1.5

jalapeno.note: 1-2 slices muddled; strain seeds unless 'hot' asked

minDoseIfPresent._exceptions: soda-water 0.75 inside a Beachcomber grog/punch shake (Navy Grog precedent); lime 0.08-0.25 as a Ti' Punch lime coin

minCoreShare.core: base spirits + primary acid + main body juice/cream/mixer, as share of pre-dilution volume

incompatibilities.why: slow curdle/bitterness if it sits; blend and serve at once
purple-brown mud unless kept apart by a sink/float
subtractive mixing: blue + yellow/amber = green/teal; may be described as aqua/turquoise but never 'blue'; never blue + dark rum

methodRules.unless: ice shell (Beachcomber's Gold) or frozen mound

methodRules.requireStep: a final float or sink line (line.float or line.sink), not shaken in

methodRules.requireLine: abv >= 35 and sugar <= 10 g/100ml, or amontillado-sherry on crushed ice

vesselFit.rule: pre-dilution single-serving liquid oz must fall in range; bowls multiply by servings. finalOz (post-dilution) must not exceed capacity for up/no-ice service.

colada.notes: coconut-milk requires added sugar; coconut-rum is accent only (<=0.5 oz)

mai-tai.exceptions: pineapple/orange allowed only for an explicit 'Royal Hawaiian' riff, labeled as such

daiquiri.notes: non-rum base must be named in the title (e.g. 'tequila daiquiri'); fruit-named daiquiri must contain that fruit

resort-punch.notes: the fun-garnish family; vodka acceptable; still needs real rum character unless prayer says otherwise

stirred.exceptions: lime <=0.25 (Corn 'n Oil wedge squeeze); coffee only as coffee-liqueur

hot.notes: butter only as hot-buttered-rum-batter or gardenia-mix

Piña Colada.require: colada rule AND rum or named spirit; riff only

Painkiller.require: riff of Painkiller: navy/dark rum, pineapple, orange, coconut-cream, nutmeg

Grog.require: grog familyRequirements OR hot rum + water + citrus/spice

Daiquiri.require: spirit + lime/lemon + sugar, no dairy, <= 5 components; non-rum base named

Punch.require: spirit + citrus + sugar + a lengthener (juice/water/soda/tea) OR bowl service

Cooler.require: long (>= 5 oz pre-dilution) AND carbonated or juice lengthener, served on ice

Highball.require: carbonated top >= 2.5 oz, built, tall glass

Fizz.require: citrus + sugar + soda-water/sparkling top; no crushed-ice mound

Flip.require: whole egg (proposed egg-whole) or egg-white + rich sweetener; nutmeg

Julep.require: mint + crushed ice + julep-cup or similar

Nightcap.require: stirred or hot, abv >= 18 or hot

Sling.require: spirit + citrus + sweetener + soda or water lengthener; (cherry liqueur classic)

garnish.about: The card's garnish is a controlled vocabulary of concrete, drawable things (web/lib/engine.js GV; web/lib/artspec.js draws the same phrases). Research notes and prayer ideas are read into it; placeholders resolve to real objects ('the named fruit' becomes the poured fruit, e.g. 'banana coin on a pick'; 'full tiki garnish' becomes 'mint bouquet', 'orchid', 'pineapple frond', each still checked) and non-objects are dropped ('none', 'seasonal fruit', rims, ice blocks, novelties).
countRules: A bowl's four include its straws: one phrase '<n> long straws' (one per guest), only on a shared crushed-ice bowl with servings > 1; never on a single serve or a ladled punch bowl.
Crushed-ice tiki (crushed, pebble, shaved, ice cone, swizzled) carries one aromatic among its three.
The Navy Grog's 'straw through the ice cone' is service and not counted.
A restrained prayer (elegance, precision, a first date) gets one garnish, plus a bowl's straws.
upHolds: cherry or fruit on a pick (incl. the Morse pick and the Saturn ring)
a dusting (nutmeg or cinnamon only on rich or creamy drinks)
decorative: three cherries and a pineapple chunk on a pick (beachcomber-spice-sour only: the Three Dots' Morse V)
duplicates: pineapple chunk and cherry on a pick
three cherries and a pineapple chunk on a pick
one element per citrus fruit (wheel, wedge, peel, shell)
one pineapple element (wedge, frond, spear, chunk)

fire.defaultFlame: Only the volcano-bowl archetype in a volcano, tiki or Scorpion bowl wears 'flaming lime shell' unasked; otherwise fire needs a prayer that asks for it, a vessel above, and a crushed or frozen cap.
fire.optionalTheater: A crushed-ice drink shared from a volcano, tiki or Scorpion bowl may offer the flame as optional theater in the steps (the Scorpion's canonical dressing is the gardenia, not fire).
rules: Any garnish containing 'flaming' forces the lighting and safety step, last: a spent lime (or lemon) shell cut side up, a sugar cube in lemon extract, a long lighter, cinnamon sparks; keep hair, sleeves, straws and flowers clear; never pour spirit from the bottle toward a flame; blow it out or cover it before anyone drinks.
A flaming lime shell needs lime in the drink; a lemon drink lights a lemon shell in the steps only.
Never with a paper umbrella or a flower on the card; a mint bouquet becomes a sprig.
Hot drinks: only an optional flamed ladle, blown out before it is stirred in.
Never on archetypes whose 'never' list rules out fire (overproof-swizzle).

truth.rule: A fruit garnish (wheel, wedge, twist, peel, shell, frond, chunk) requires that fruit among the poured lines, and nothing the guest refused ever appears (pineapple frond included). Exceptions: decorative items (cherries, umbrellas, mint, flowers, spice), the orange slice-and-cherry flag only with orange in, an expressed orange peel on a stirred drink (its oil is the classic seasoning), and the Three Dots' Morse pick.

navy-grog: straw through the ice cone (cone service)
trinidad-swizzle: swizzle stick left in (the Angostura crown is a build step)
beachcomber-spice-sour: three cherries and a pineapple chunk on a pick (Three Dots) or long orange-peel spiral (Nui Nui)
hurricane: orange slice and cherry flag (with orange in), else lemon wheel + paper umbrella + cherry on a pick

punch.punchBowl: a ladled punch bowl takes only what floats or dusts: nutmeg, citrus wheels floating, flowers, mint

Queen's Park Swizzle: Angostura crown (a build step in the method)
Three Dots and a Dash: three cherries and a pineapple chunk on a pick

tackyNever: salt rim (tiki, except li-hing-mui with li-hing-mui-syrup)
umbrella on up or stirred drink
cherry sunk in a Mai Tai

copy.headlineFlavorRule: A flavor word may headline (tagline, first sentence of tasting) only if it is the FIRST flavor tag of an ingredient present at >= its minDose (or >= 0.25 oz for liqueurs/syrups, >= 1 dash for bitters as 'spice'), or is produced by a garnish aroma (mint, nutmeg, cinnamon). Secondary tags of base spirits (e.g. banana/pineapple/tropical on Jamaican rum; lychee on elderflower; almond/ginger on falernum) may only appear hedged ('a banana-ish funk from the Jamaican rum').
copy.colorWordsRequire: computed drink color (optics) in the named hue family
copy.prayerTrace: Every generated drink must record >= 1 ingredient decision and >= 1 presentation decision (vessel, garnish, look) caused by the prayer; two prayers with different content words must not yield identical ingredient sets at the same seed.

colorQuick.note: Summary for copy-truth only; detailed optics live in the color workstream.

murky.reads: green to teal (call it aqua/turquoise if pale)

layers.sink: dense syrup/liqueur last, down the side: red base (grenadine/cassis/blackberry) under orange/yellow body
layers.float: dark rum / overproof / sherry on top: dark cap fading down through crushed ice
layers.crown: Angostura on crushed-ice dome: red-brown cap; QPS = green base (mint), gold body, red crown
layers.stormCloud: black rum poured last over ginger beer

redFlags.fix: pineapple-juice 2-4 oz + coconut-cream 0.75-1.5 oz, or relabel

redFlags.check: coconut sources present but none of coconut-cream/coconut-milk
no line.float of dark rum, no line.sink of grenadine

redFlags.fix: gold column + Jamaican + 0.75-1 oz 151 Demerara; Don's Mix; falernum

redFlags.check: grenadine <= 0.17 oz; no coconutSources, allDairy, blue-curacao

redFlags.fix: lime + white grapefruit + honey or allspice
strip to spirit, citrus, sugar (+ named fruit)

redFlags.check: vessel not in upVessels and ice != none

redFlags.fix: no ice, no fizz, peel not juice

redFlags.check: the riff keeps its source archetype's required signature components and archetypeAromaRequired garnish
servings >= 2; and servings >= 4 => bowl or batch
prayer naming a classic or pop drink (e.g. 'Blue Hawaii', 'Elvis in Blue Hawaii') yields a riff that keeps that classic's signature (blue-curacao + pineapple for Blue Hawaii)
count(coconutSources) > 2 OR (coconut-rum AND coconut-cream AND any allDairy)
redFlags.fix: one cream of coconut (+ <=0.5 coconut rum)
1 tsp seasoning or a deliberate sink

redFlags.check: each overproof <= 1.0 (1.5 if sole base); count(overproof) <= 1; total spirits <= 4.0; ethanol <= 2.0 oz
redFlags.fix: 0.75-1 oz overproof in a 3-4 oz stack

redFlags.check: butter only when method == hot; prefer hot-buttered-rum-batter
every fruit/food word in name, tagline or prayer-as-request maps to a present ingredient at minDose; frozen banana requires 'banana' (fresh), not only banana-liqueur
drink contains >= 1 of creamyMakers or hot-buttered-rum-batter or creme-de-cacao/coffee-liqueur/banana-liqueur/vanilla-syrup AND no grapefruit
coconut-milk without coconut-cream requires >= 0.5 oz simple-equivalent sweetener
sum(sweetLiqueurs oz) <= 1.5 unless archetype is liqueur-based (rum-runner, chartreuse swizzle, resort)
sweet/tart/balanced words consistent with sugarToAcid position within family window (lower third = tart, upper third = sweet)
muddled mint + up service requires fine-strain step

fire garnish only in garnish.fireAllowedVessels; fuel is lemon-extract crouton (or overproof in a well), never poured from bottle; not with mint bouquet/umbrella adjacent; copy never says 'flaming 151 float'
ice-cone only family grog (or explicit request) in dof/rocks
ice == none and vessel in opaqueVessels (except hot-mug for hot)
vessel not in upVessels unless method == stir
vessel in [coconut, pineapple] requires crushed ice and method != stir
no garnish signals (garnish.truth.signals) an excluded ingredient or avoided flavor tag
service up => no forbiddenOnUp items and <= 1 element
no salt/sugar rim unless li-hing-mui-syrup present
whipped cream only when prayer asks dessert and drink is blended/creamy
grated nutmeg only on colada, punch, hot, swizzle (Chartreuse/151), creamy or rum-rich drinks; not on a lean up daiquiri
incompatibilities.blue-goes-green (copy/name color word must be aqua/turquoise/teal/green, not blue)
'clear/crystal' copy forbidden if any opaqueMakers present; 'creamy' requires creamyMakers
angostura mixed (not crown) <= 0.09 oz when drink is pale/white (coconut-cream, clear bases)
every nameNouns entry present in name satisfies its require
copy.noRepeatedWords and maxFlavorAdjectivesInTagline and tagline has a verb or a noun phrase beyond the adjective list

classic drink names (Mai Tai, Zombie, Painkiller, Navy Grog, Jungle Bird, Hurricane, Scorpion, Fog Cutter, Piña Colada, Saturn, Three Dots and a Dash) only in riffs that pass that archetype's signature
'rich' requires sugarConc >= 8 or creamyMakers or dark/navy/demerara rum >= 1 oz
name not of form 'The X's Y'; 'of <Place>' only when a spirit from that place >= 1 oz or the prayer names it
tagline words within copy.taglineWords; tasting <= 3 sentences

sweetEquivalentsPerOz.about: oz of 1:1 simple syrup with the same sugar, and oz of lime with the same acid, per oz of ingredient (from data/ingredients.json)
